mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals contraction in manufacturing output, which depresses earnings for industrial firms and drags down S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and core CPI inflation above 2% for two months signals a dual monetary and inflationary shock, which increases uncertainty and risk premia, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp month-on-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% signals a collapse in residential investment, which negatively impacts construction and related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both unemployment rate and payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a paradoxical labor market shock (e.g., job destruction outpacing creation), which reduces aggregate demand and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises AND PAYEMS falls in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent year-over-year decline in real personal income (proxied by GDPC1 per capita, but using GDPC1 as available) for three consecutive quarters signals weakening consumer purchasing power, which reduces demand for goods and services and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days if the market anticipates policy stimulus.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < 0% for 3 consecutive quarters
regime_hint: protracted economic slowdown with expected policy response
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> 0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
